name: better-videos-for-instagram
description: Easily control the playback and volume of Instagram videos.
author: Emir Kabal <me@emirkabal.com>

scripts.build: bun x --bun wxt build && bun scripts/check-build.cjs chrome-mv3
scripts.build:firefox: bun x --bun wxt build -b firefox --mv2 && bun scripts/check-build.cjs firefox-mv2
scripts.package: bun x --bun wxt zip && bun scripts/check-build.cjs chrome-mv3
scripts.package:firefox: bun x --bun wxt zip -b firefox --mv2 && bun scripts/check-build.cjs firefox-mv2
scripts.package-all: bun run package && bun run package:firefox
